## Interpretation / limitations

1. Direct call xrefs to an import thunk are the strongest static evidence. Data-xref/indirect-call candidates are deliberately marked low confidence.
2. Arguments are recovered by a bounded backward scan of the current function and basic-block-like region. Register values crossing branches or prior calls may be unresolved.
3. A `VoiceControl` parameter chain is decoded only when its pointer resolves to a mapped static address. Stack/heap-generated chains are represented by candidate parameter IDs and must be confirmed by tracing.
4. Raw bytes and pointee previews are preserved in JSON so field offsets can be checked rather than trusted blindly.
5. Imports not present in this EBOOT are not evidence that an export is unused in every game/version. The current inventory is tied to this exact EBOOT/database.
